title: WPMS/1236/2018 of Om Prakesh Panday Vs State Of Uttarakhand Through Secretary AND OTHERS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
 Writ Petition (M/S) No.1236 of 2018
Om Prakesh Panday ÖÖÖ.Petitioner

Versus
State of Uttarakhand & others
 ÖRespondents
Present:- Mr. B.S. Adhikari, Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. Yogesh Pandey, Additional CSC for the State/respondents.
Honíble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J. (Oral)
 On 03.05.2018, this Court passed the following
order:-
ìMr. B.S. Adhikari, Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. Yogesh Pandey, Additional C.S.C. for the
State/respondents.
Three weeksí time is granted to the
respondents to file counter affidavit.
List this case on 30.05.2018 in the daily cause
list.
Meanwhile, petitioner is directed to deposit the
penalty of Rs.1,34,860/- (Rupees One Lakh
Thirty Four Thousand Eight Hundred Sixty
Only) as demanded vide order dated
13.03.2018 before the Registrar General of this
Court within a period of one week. The amount
if deposited by the petitioner shall be kept in
the fixed deposit with some nationalized bank
so that it may earn interest.
In case the penalty is not deposited by the
petitioner within a period of one week, the writ
petition shall be deemed to be dismissed in
limine.î
2. Since the amount was not deposited by the
petitioner in time, the writ petition stood dismissed. Now the
petitioner has belatedly moved an application (CLMA No.8602

2
of 2018) along with a demand draft of Rs.1,34,860/- (Rupees
One Lakh Thirty Four Thousand Eight Hundred Sixty Only).
3. In the interest of justice, Miscellaneous
application is allowed. The order dated 03.05.2018 is hereby
recalled.
4. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
5. The petitioner was granted permission by the
respondent authorities to store riverbed material. On
inspection, it was found that the storage of the riverbed
material by the petitioner was more than the permissible limit.
Consequently, a penalty was imposed upon the petitioner vide
order dated 09.10.2017 by the concerned authority. Aggrieved,
the petitioner filed an appeal before the appellate authority,
which was also dismissed by the appellate authority vide order
dated 13.03.2018. Hence, the present writ petition before this
Court.
6. The case of the petitioner is that the appellate
authority has not considered the report of the Mining
Department which is in favour of the petitioner.
7. Considering the overall facts and circumstances
of the case as well as the fact that the appellate authority has
not considered the report of the Mining Department, the writ
petition is partly allowed. The impugned order dated
13.03.2018 is hereby set aside.
8. Against the order of recovery, the petitioner shall
file a fresh appeal before the appellate authority within a
period of one week from the date of production of a certified
copy of this order. The appellate authority shall consider the

3
matter, including the report of the Mining Department but
before considering the appeal of the petitioner, the amount of
Rs.1,34,860/- (Rupees One Lakh Thirty Four Thousand Eight
Hundred Sixty Only), which this Court directed the petitioner
to deposit vide order dated 03.05.2018, shall be deposited by
the petitioner before the appellate authority.
9. Registry shall return the demand draft of
Rs.1,34,860/- (Rupees One Lakh Thirty Four Thousand Eight
Hundred Sixty Only) on an application moved by the
petitioner.
10. Registrar General of this Court is hereby directed
to apprise the appellate authority of this order as well.
 (Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.)
 10.07.2018
Ankit/
